name: Icon
description: Sizes and colours any icon so it lines up with the text beside it.

weight.description: Optional icon style/weight hint (forwarded when supported by the icon component)

tone.description: Semantic colour. Reserve success, warning and danger for real state; omit to inherit currentColor

color.description: Text-hierarchy colour, the same axis as Text color. tone wins when both are set

iconProps.description: Additional props forwarded to the underlying icon component (typed from the icon prop in TypeScript)

when: A symbol sits beside text, inside a button, or leads a list item
guidelines: Reserve the success, warning, and danger tones for real state
Match weight to the text weight beside it
iconProps reaches options the wrapper does not expose
accessibility: Icons ship aria-hidden — they are decoration until you label them
An icon-only button needs VisuallyHidden text
Color alone never carries the message

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Inherits the size and color of its surroundings.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: Steps tuned to the type scale, so icons never float off the baseline.

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: Tone states carry meaning — never use them for decoration.

examples.name: Hierarchy
examples.description: The text colour ladder, for glyphs that sit beside secondary or tertiary copy.

examples.name: Weights
examples.description: Match the stroke to the text weight next to it.

examples.name: Advanced Icon Props
examples.description: iconProps passes anything the underlying icon package supports.
